zh.d:
本版桌面端的重头是技能市场与专家市场的整体重做，以及一批只有真的用起来才暴露的界面缺陷。

【新增】
· 技能市场：141 个内置技能按 13 个分类整理完毕（零漏分、零空分类），改成与专家市场同一套四列卡片网格；分类与来源（内置 / 自定义 / 团队）两条筛选并排；卡片上直接「使用」「编辑」；标签页补上数量徽章，此前只有它没有
· 专家市场：252 位专家的名称、简介与分类全部本地化到 13 种语言。原始语料里没有任何语言字段，所以切到英文界面时这一整片以前仍是中文。同时一行从三位改成四位——网格本来就要求四列，但断点定在 1280px，而设置窗口宽度在 1200px 附近，那条规则从来没生效过
· 会话输入框的技能选择器改成列表：图标、名称、描述，团队下发的带「团队」标记。原来是一格格图标缩略图配截断的名字，个人几个技能够用，企业下发几百个机器生成的英文标识之后完全没法读
· 企业成员在客户端里：输入框下方常驻场景卡片网格、资源卡片显示配图；每轮对话上报缓存 token、耗时与请求 id，个人渠道的用量也能对上账

【优化改进】
· 技能卡与专家卡统一成同一套骨架：图标与徽章一行、标题单行不换行、描述两行保底、操作固定在卡片底部。此前卡片会因描述长短参差不齐，每张还白占约 70px
· 「使用此技能」以前点下去没有任何反馈，无法判断是否生效
· 安装器不再要求用户去关一个 Windows 根本没点名的进程

【修复】
· 卡片边框与粘性表头一直是全透明的。bg-bg-3、border-border-2 这类类名在本项目里根本不存在——色板的键是 base/1/2/3/4，同时供 bg- 和 border- 使用，多写一层前缀就不会生成任何样式规则，颜色回落成透明。全仓 71 个文件共 176 处，表现为：暗色模式下技能与专家卡片看不出轮廓，粘性表头没有底色、内容从它下面透出来滚过去。9 月 11 日那次「暗色模式卡片消失」的修复写的正是这个失效类名，因此从未生效，这一版才真正落地
· 企业场景面板不再遮住输入框。它原本挂在输入框下边缘的一颗小药丸上、向上弹出，正好盖住用户要打字的地方；现在是输入框下方常驻的卡片网格，位于正常文档流中，结构上不可能浮起来遮挡任何东西
· 关于页的三个链接全是死链，指向的旧仓库地址已经 404
· 技能选择器上的「团队」标记拿不到数据：接口一直在返回来源字段，设置页也在用，只有会话页自己那次取列表时把它丢掉了
· 技能的分类与本地化文案此前是按「来源」匹配的，导致用户自己导入的技能会错误套用内置语料的文案
· 媒体：Agnes 视频 2.5 一直被按 2.0 的请求格式发送；Agnes 图片沿用了与其不兼容的请求体，并错误地按「一次返回 4 张」处理；上游队列已满时现在能识别并如实提示，不再报成未知错误

本版把管理后台逐页对齐了竞品，并补上了此前缺失的最后一块：接入企业自己的存储。以下改进运行在企业服务端，更新服务端后生效。

【新增】
· 文件管理：接入企业自己的存储并浏览内容。兼容 S3 协议的对象存储（自建 MinIO / Ceph，或阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、华为云 OBS、七牛等公有云）都能用，选一下预设就会自动填好 Endpoint 与寻址方式；企业内网 NAS 通过 WebDAV 接入，群晖 / 威联通 / TrueNAS / Windows Server 勾一个开关即可。访问密钥只写不读，存储后不再回显，浏览被限制在配置的前缀之内
· API 资产可以手工创建，不再只能导入接口文档：资产编码、分类、工具前缀、基础 URL、认证方式与认证配置、启用状态、描述。没有接口文档的服务也能登记，随后在资产内逐条声明接口操作，发布出去的技能里就会带上真实可调用的接口
· 记忆授权独立成页：一眼看清全企业哪些成员或部门对哪个记忆集合有只读或读写权限，可直接撤销。此前只能逐个集合打开抽屉查看
· 技能、工具 (MCP)、数字员工、项目组成为一级入口。它们的能力一直都在，只是埋在二级标签页里，按名字找不到
· 记忆集合新增概览统计与作用域筛选，并显示近期提炼记录（合并了多少、裁剪了多少）
· 审批中心新增总数、待审批、已通过、已拒绝四项统计，以及按五类审批类型筛选
· 配置项新增统计卡、导入模板下载与逐集合导出，导出时敏感值自动脱敏
· 首页新增进阶配置向导，把开局要做的事串成引导流程

【优化改进】
· IM 管道从「企业设置」移到「资源管理」，与模型、技能、工具放在一起
· 全部后台页面统一标题样式，标题与侧边栏取自同一处文案，不会再各写各的
· 操作审计页信息呈现优化

【修复】
· 记忆提炼的运行记录此前只写不读：每次合并与裁剪都记进了数据库，但没有任何接口能查回来，界面上只能弹一个转瞬即逝的提示。现在概览里的「本周合并 / 本周裁剪」和「近期提炼记录」都是真实数据
· 编辑资产时留空的字段会被存成空字符串而不是「未设置」，导致「工具前缀留空则沿用资产编码」这条规则失效
· 手工创建的资产被错标成「OpenAPI 3.x」
· 创建或保存失败时，提示框显示的是未翻译的原始文案标识
· 配置项的导入模板自身无法回环——模板里的字段说明行会被当成一条配置导入
· 「已生成技能：{name}」这类提示中的占位符没有被替换，13 种语言全部受影响；站内消息未读数的占位符此前只修了中英文，其余 11 种语言一直显示原始占位符
· 账单管理页的文案此前全部硬编码中文，且加载失败时会把接口原始报文直接弹给用户
· 提炼记录在其记忆集合被删除后显示一串内部标识

企业服务端与桌面客户端独立更新，需要获取对应版本请与我们联系。

en.d:
The desktop side of this release is mostly a rebuild of the skills and expert marketplaces, plus a batch of interface defects that only surfaced from actually using the panes.

[New]
· Skills marketplace: all 141 built-in skills are now sorted into 13 categories (none unassigned, none empty), browsed in the same four-up card grid as the expert marketplace. Category and source (built-in / custom / team) filters sit side by side, cards carry Use and Edit directly, and the tab finally has the count badge every other tab had
· Expert marketplace: names, descriptions and categories for all 252 experts are localized across 13 languages. The source corpus carries no locale fields at all, so this whole pane stayed Chinese whatever language you picked. Four per row as well — the grid had always asked for four columns, but at a 1280px breakpoint, and the settings window sits near 1200px, so that rule never applied
· The composer's skill picker is now a list: icon, name, description, and a Team badge for team-distributed skills. It used to be a dense grid of icon tiles with truncated names — fine for a handful of personal skills, unreadable once a team distributes hundreds of them under machine-generated English slugs
· For enterprise members: a standing scene card grid below the composer, artwork on managed resource cards, and per-turn reporting of cache tokens, duration and request id, so personal-channel usage reconciles too

[Improved]
· Skill and expert cards now share one skeleton: icon and badge on one row, a single untruncated title line, a two-line description floor, and actions pinned to the card's bottom. Cards used to drift out of alignment with the length of their description, each wasting about 70px
· "Use this skill" gave no feedback at all, so there was no way to tell whether it had worked
· The installer no longer asks users to close a process Windows never named

[Fixed]
· Card borders and sticky headers had been fully transparent. Class names like bg-bg-3 and border-border-2 do not exist in this project — the palette's keys are base/1/2/3/4, serving both bg- and border-, so the extra prefix generates no rule at all and the color falls back to transparent. 176 occurrences across 71 files, showing up as skill and expert cards with no visible outline in dark mode, and sticky headers with no background that content scrolls through. The September 11 fix for "dark mode loses the cards" was written with exactly this dead class name, so it never took effect; it lands now
· The enterprise scene panel no longer covers the composer. It hung off a small pill on the composer's bottom edge and opened upward, directly over the box you were about to type in. It is now a standing card grid below the input, in normal flow, where it cannot float over anything
· All three links in the About panel were dead, pointing at a repository address that now 404s
· The Team badge on the skill picker had no data to render from: the API had always returned the source field and the settings page already used it, but the conversation page's own fetch of the same list dropped it
· Skill categories and localized text were matched on "source", so a user's own imported skill could wrongly inherit the built-in corpus's text
· Media: Agnes video 2.5 had been sent the 2.0 request shape; Agnes image reused a request body incompatible with it, and was handled as if one request returned four images; a provider whose own queue is full is now recognized and reported as such instead of an unknown error

This release brings the admin console in line with the reference product page by page, and closes the last thing it was missing: connecting the company's own storage. Everything below runs on the enterprise server and takes effect once that server is updated.

[New]
· File management: connect your own storage and browse it. Any S3-compatible object store works — self-hosted MinIO or Ceph, or Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, Huawei OBS, Qiniu — and a preset fills in the endpoint and addressing style for you. An on-premise NAS connects over WebDAV, which Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS and Windows Server all expose with a single switch. Access secrets are write-only and never shown again once stored, and browsing is confined to the configured prefix
· API assets can be written by hand rather than only imported from a document: asset code, category, tool prefix, base URL, authentication method and configuration, enabled state, description. A service with no published document can be registered and then given its operations one by one, so the published skill carries endpoints an agent can actually call
· Memory grants get their own page: who — member or department — can read or write which memory collection, across the whole company, revocable in place. Previously this meant opening each collection's drawer in turn
· Skills, MCP tools, digital employees and project groups are now top-level entries. The capabilities were always there, buried in second-level tabs where nobody could find them by name
· Memory collections gain overview figures, a scope filter, and the recent distillation runs behind them
· The approval centre gains total / pending / approved / rejected counts and a filter over the five approval kinds
· Config sets gain overview figures, a downloadable import template, and per-set export with sensitive values masked
· The home screen gains a guided advanced-setup journey

[Improved]
· IM channels moved from Enterprise settings into Resources, alongside models, skills and tools
· Every console page now carries the same page header, titled from the same string the sidebar uses, so the two cannot drift apart
· Clearer presentation on the audit log page

[Fixed]
· The memory distillation ledger was write-only: every merge and trim had been recorded, but nothing could read it back, so the console could only show a toast that vanished. This week's merged and trimmed counts, and the recent runs, are now real rows
· Clearing a field while editing an asset stored an empty string rather than "unset", which defeated the rule that an empty tool prefix falls back to the asset code
· A hand-written asset was labelled "OpenAPI 3.x"
· A failed create or save showed an untranslated internal string identifier in the toast
· The config-set import template could not be re-imported — its own column-description line was read as a config entry
· Placeholders in messages such as "Skill generated: {name}" were never substituted, in all 13 languages; the unread-notifications count had been fixed only in Chinese and English, leaving the other 11 showing the raw placeholder
· The billing page had every string hardcoded in Chinese and, on a failed load, showed the raw API envelope to the user
· A distillation record showed an internal identifier once its memory collection was deleted

The enterprise server and the desktop client update independently; contact us for the matching server build.
